name: reforger-script-tools
description: Enfusion Script language support and Workbench compiler integration for Arma Reforger.

reforgerScriptTools.diagnostics.enabled.description: Write detailed local extension and language-server support logs after the VS Code window is reloaded. Enable only while investigating a problem; logs exclude source text and LSP payloads. In the Search UI, Ctrl+F3 records a bounded snapshot of the current query, filters, paging, warnings, and result metadata.

reforgerScriptTools.experimentalAutoForm.title: Experimental: Auto Formatting
reforgerScriptTools.experimentalAutoForm.description: Apply experimental automatic source edits, including typing assists and preprocessor directive separators.

reforgerScriptTools.bracketColoring.title: Bracket Coloring
reforgerScriptTools.bracketColoring.markdownDescription: Choose how Enfusion Script brackets are colored across VS Code windows. **Semantic Owner Colors** follows the nearest type, callable, variable, attribute, or keyword. **Punctuation Color** uses the Reforger Semantic Palette's punctuation color. **Visual Studio Code Colors** uses native bracket-pair coloring and matching. This setting controls the Enforce-specific VS Code bracket presentation settings.

reforgerScriptTools.workbench.enabled.title: Workbench: Enabled
reforgerScriptTools.workbench.enabled.description: Enable Workbench integration, including NET API status checks, compiler validation, and the consent-gated managed bridge installer. On first activation, the extension asks whether to enable it.

reforgerScriptTools.workbench.host.title: Workbench NET API: Host
reforgerScriptTools.workbench.host.description: Loopback address for the Workbench NET API. The extension never scans for or changes this endpoint.
reforgerScriptTools.workbench.host.patternErrorMessage: Use a loopback host such as 127.0.0.1 or ::1.

reforgerScriptTools.workbench.port.title: Workbench NET API: Port
reforgerScriptTools.workbench.port.description: Port for the configured Workbench NET API endpoint. The extension never probes other ports.

reforgerScriptTools.workbench.saveOnIdle.title: Workbench NET API: Save and Validate On Idle
reforgerScriptTools.workbench.saveOnIdle.description: Save the active Enforce Script and validate in Workbench after three seconds without typing. Disable to validate only after explicit saves or the Validate Scripts command.

reforgerScriptTools.workbench.winePrefix.title: Workbench: Wine Prefix
reforgerScriptTools.workbench.winePrefix.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Wine prefix that runs Workbench on a host that does not run it natively, such as `~/.steam/steam/steamapps/compatdata/1874910/pfx`. Leave empty to resolve Steam's Proton compatibility data for the Arma Reforger Tools app, or the `WINEPREFIX` environment variable, automatically. Ignored on Windows.

enumDescriptions: Load every compatible external index already available in the local index cache.
Load the opened project's offline dependency indexes, including the base-game dependency, then replace them with the current Workbench graph when Workbench connects.
Do not load external add-on indexes. Workspace scripts remain available.
reforgerScriptTools.workbench.externalIn.title: External Indexes
reforgerScriptTools.workbench.externalIn.description: Choose which cached external indexes are available when Workbench NET API is unavailable.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node tools/check-workbench-bridge-style.mjs && node tools/build-language-server.mjs && node esbuild.js
scripts.package:build: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node tools/check-workbench-bridge-style.mjs && npm run mcp-api:check && node tools/build-language-server.mjs --release && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run mcp-api:check
